protocol.sampling: Unmodified Environment circle/random sampler, all128 fresh unique seeds in frozen order, disjoint from original teacher worlds and reserved validation/diagnostic seeds. All failures retained; no near-goal starts or interventions.
protocol.information_boundary: Student gets ordinary local9/task4/GRU64. Local teacher consumes only actual local9 and calibration/history; commands remain teacher labels, never actor inputs. No GT poses/IDs/counts/hit classes/targets or contact flags. Separate diagnostic local-teacher-state sidecar contains derived teacher state only and is not used as actor input or in the planned imitation loss.
protocol.execution: All5 robots execute student deterministic means for all300 steps. Teacher advances every step on actual student history but never intervenes. Reset only at episode start. Teacher state is not deployed.

training_plan.fresh_actor: GRU64 with saved zero command encoder columns; all other seed11 initial tensors exact to original no-command stage
training_plan.budget_comparison: 256 episodes x40 epochs equals128 x80 baseline total samples and6400 optimizer steps. Fresh training, not extending old weights. Added student-state diversity replaces repeated exposure to the original dataset.
training_plan.selection: Only final epoch40, deterministic circle/random on seeds2001/2003/2011/2017/2027. Require5/5 official successes AND5/5 final holds before any larger gate or separately planned RL; otherwise stop without extension. Unchanged thresholds/timeout/safety. No teacher or runtime wrapper at evaluation.
training_plan.scope: Imitation-only student-state aggregation; no GRU-RL, multi-task, fresh-heldout, multi-training-seed or physical acceptance.

scope: Unassisted failed-student trajectories with local teacher labels. No learned success, automatic RL, final-heldout or hardware acceptance.
